_help: Base configuration. Put real values in onboarding.config.local.json (same folder, git-ignored) - it is merged over this file. CyberArk service-user credentials are NEVER stored here; the script prompts for them at run time.

cyberark._help: identityUrl / apiBaseUrl are optional full-URL overrides. Leave blank to derive them from identityTenantId / subdomain.

azureBlob._help: SAS token needs Create+Write on the container. If the upload fails the run continues, the failure is logged, and the file is queued in logs\PendingUploads.csv for manual upload / automatic retry on the next run.

descriptions._help: Final description = <admin description><separator><suffixTemplate>. MaxLength 0 = no limit. The admin part is trimmed (never the suffix) if the limit would be exceeded.

managingCpm._help: Fill in your CPM names. Precedence when a Tier is present: CSV ManagingCPM column, byRegionTier[REGION-TIER], byTier[TIER], byRegion[REGION], default. If a CPM is not accepted by the tenant (e.g. it does not exist in non-prod) the next one is tried and finally the safe is created with a BLANK CPM (see safeDefaults.fallbackToBlankCpm; set it to false to fail instead). Blank everywhere = no CPM (a warning is logged).
